combination: Independent continuous measurements; contradictions retained; no eight-gate decision tree. Local support and global completeness are separate claims.

T1.name: Coherent darkness
T1.measurement: Normal-side brightness versus central strip, persistence over five adjacent tangent samples; raw and sustained dark contrast retained.
T1.limits: A coherent internal shadow can resemble an external edge.

T2.name: Brightness continuity
T2.measurement: Normal brightness drop and recovery, continuous bright-material cut penalty, with short profiles saved per segment.
T2.limits: Diffuse illumination gradients can imitate edges; a bright detour does not erase a dark seam.

T3.name: Color continuity
T3.measurement: Brightness-normalized RGB side differences weighted by available illumination, coherent along tangent.
T3.limits: Neutral highlights and dark pixels have weak material-color evidence.

T4.name: Competing highlights
T4.measurement: Inclusion of other independently detected features under primary, alternative and perturbed contours; pair separation profile.
T4.limits: Sharing a region does not establish common physical ownership.

T5.name: Internal darkness
T5.measurement: Enclosed dark components, dark valleys inside the candidate and competing contour disagreement; retained as internal-versus-external ambiguity.
T5.limits: No automatic physical hole or shadow identity claim.

T6.name: Occlusion boundaries
T6.measurement: Coherent side color transition or sustained one-sided brightness step without recovery, including edges without a deep valley.
T6.limits: An edge alone does not identify the occluding physical bead.

T7.name: Boundary completeness
T7.measurement: Supported edge length, connected supported arcs, unresolved gaps, border contact and stability of each segment.
T7.limits: The optimizer's mathematical closure is never photographic closure.

T8.name: Measurement reliability
T8.measurement: Illuminated core pixels, local contrast, resolution, parameter perturbation IoU and centroid spread, search expansion.
T8.limits: Parameter sensitivity is not calibrated physical or ownership confidence.

extension_rule: New mechanisms become permanent categories; improve general measurements, run all regressions and fresh reserved cases in a later round. No coordinate exceptions.
